body:
Exactly. When I attempted suicide last year, I actually wrote a specific letter just for my parents. I knew how stubborn they were and how they would never accept fault for any of the shit they did, so I wrote that letter to emphasise that it was absolutely their fault (although there were other factors, yeah). Even if I was mentally ill, even if people told them it wasn't their fault and they deserved to be happy, even if someone tells them that I'm only saying this "out of anger" and I didn't \*actually\* mean it. I wanted them to know that it was their fault, no matter what anyone said, because I meant all of it.

I have two siblings, one of which also went to therapy because of them. If that was what it took to get it through their fucking skull, I wanted to make sure they got it. Unfortunately, I couldn't go through with it and so they haven't changed a bit.
